sentences.text: The evidence does not provide a maximum interest rate for MSE loans. [E15, E17, E18]

The in-force UCB directions provided here address penal charges for default, floating-rate loan disclosures, and pre-payment charges for certain business-purpose floating-rate loans, but they do not state a ceiling on the interest rate for MSE loans. [E2, E11, E15, E17, E18]
